read.en: SanDisk fell 5.3% on Oct 14 to $1,403.34 and is down 17% in five sessions. It is below its 5-day ($1,512.9), 10-day ($1,612.9), falling 30-day ($1,666.6) and 100-day ($1,648.1) averages and above the 200-day ($1,199.7). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 2 and is below zero, Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 6 ($1,762.5), and RSI is 34.
read.zh: 闪迪 10月14日下跌 5.3%，收于 $1,403.34，五个交易日下跌 17%。股价位于 5 日（$1,512.9）、10 日（$1,612.9）、下行的 30 日（$1,666.6）和 100 日均线（$1,648.1）下方，并在 200 日均线（$1,199.7）上方。MACD 自 10月2日起位于信号线下方并在零轴之下，抛物线 SAR 自 10月6日起看空（$1,762.5），RSI 为 34。

read.en: The $1,465–1,475 floor, held on closes since June, broke on the close and becomes resistance, followed by $1,504–1,513 (Sep 16 low, 5-day average) and $1,613 (10-day). The day's low of $1,402.02 retested the Oct 13 low ($1,401), the last support before $1,325 (Jul 17 low) and $998 (Jul 29 low). A close below $1,401 would open $1,325.
read.zh: 6月以来收盘均守住的 $1,465–1,475 底部收盘失守，转为阻力，其上为 $1,504–1,513（9月16日低点、5 日均线）和 $1,613（10 日均线）。当日低点 $1,402.02 再测 10月13日低点（$1,401），这是 $1,325（7月17日低点）和 $998（7月29日低点）之前的最后支撑。若收盘跌破 $1,401，下一目标看 $1,325。

r.en: Former floor, held on closes since June ($1,465–1,475)
